I'm unable to complete this task at the moment because **all external tools are currently returning a "permission required but no prompt available" error**. This affected every tool I tried:

- **bash** (curl) — blocked
- **webfetch** — blocked
- **websearch** — blocked
- **read/glob** (local project files) — blocked

This appears to be a system-level permission issue on the environment, not an issue with the URLs themselves.

---

### What I was asked to fetch

| # | URL | Purpose |
|---|-----|---------|
| 1 | `connectedpapers.com/search?q=DeepFruits` | Find the DeepFruits paper on Connected Papers |
| 2 | `api.semanticscholar.org/.../paper/search?query=DeepFruits&limit=5` | Semantic Scholar search for DeepFruits |
| 3 | `api.semanticscholar.org/.../paper/DOI:10.1109/IVCNZ.2016.15` | Direct Semantic Scholar record for the DOI |
| 4 | `scholar.google.com/scholar?q=DeepFruits+fruit+detection+2016` | Google Scholar results |
| 5 | `arxiv.org/search/?query=DeepFruits&searchtype=all` | arXiv results |

The DOI `10.1109/IVCNZ.2016.15` corresponds to the **DeepFruits paper** ("DeepFruits — A Deep Learning Approach for Robust Fruit Detection in Unstructured Environments") published at **IVCNZ 2016**.

```bash

curl -s -L -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://arxiv.org/search/?query=DeepFruits&searchtype=all"
```
